description: PostgreSQL-style INSERT ... ON CONFLICT (...) DO UPDATE is already valid sqlite3 (3.24+); Rewrite must leave it untouched rather than mistaking it for something to translate -- this is a regression check that the dialect-rewrite feature didn't break the native upsert path

body: CREATE TABLE tH{{DLID}} (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, name TEXT)
INSERT INTO tH{{DLID}} (id, name) VALUES (1, 'updated') ON CONFLICT (id) DO UPDATE SET name = excluded.name
SELECT name FROM tH{{DLID}} WHERE id = 1
